stage0046b_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$マキ$$
「Nothing's changed since that panic before...
　It's been the same the whole time」

stage0046b_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$n
「...Will these two stay like this forever...?」

stage0046b_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$n
「Staying like this forever...
　and someday not just hearts, but bodies too...」

stage0046b_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$マキ$$
「If you don't mind, will you tell me?」

stage0046b_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$マキ$$
「Just a little is fine...
　Tell me about yourself」

stage0046b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アルト$$
「About $$ジン$$...
　guess they're shaken up over it too...」

stage0046b_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ミサト$$ took him to $$第３新東京市$$.
　Sounds like they're staying the night」

stage0046b_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$シン$$
「I wonder... if he's really okay...」

stage0046b_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$シン$$
「Fight long enough, and this happens...
　Even if you understand that in your head...」

stage0046b_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$カレン$$
「It was like this with $$カミナ$$ too...
　Even knowing you have to move on, recover...」

stage0046b_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$オードリー$$
「...For now... let's just grieve...
　and mourn the one we lost...」

stage0046b_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$ユノハ$$'s still holed up in her room, huh...」

stage0046b_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「She won't answer, no matter how we call...」

stage0046b_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（This man... I'm no good with him...）

stage0046b_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$不動$$
「Tomorrow's funeral for $$ジン・ムソウ$$...
　get $$ユノハ・スルール$$ out of her room」

stage0046b_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「No...!
　I just want to leave her be for now...!」

stage0046b_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$不動$$
「Elements are duty-bound to bond with
　others through joining. Selfishly
　sinking into solitude isn't allowed...」

stage0046b_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$不動$$
「Have you forgotten?
　$$ユノハ$$'s Element ability is to vanish...」

stage0046b_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$不動$$
「Losing $$ジン・ムソウ$$ could make her power
　run wild enough to destroy herself...」

stage0046b_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Right now, $$ユノハ$$ thinks $$ジン$$ left her behind...」

stage0046b_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I... understand that.
　How it feels to be left behind...」

stage0046b_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Because I was... left behind by my mom too...」

stage0046b_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That mom I'm talking about is the one
　who played $$シルフィ$$ in '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$'...
　She's $$アリシア$$」

stage0046b_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アリシア$$ is... $$アマタ$$'s mom...」

stage0046b_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Mom leapt over fate so easily,
　left me behind, and went off somewhere...
　I couldn't do anything, just watched her go...」

stage0046b_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「To my mom, I was a kid she didn't need...」

stage0046b_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「You weren't left behind, $$アマタ$$...!
　You're still connected to your mom, even now...!」

stage0046b_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$ユノハ$$'s the same...!
　So I'll... go bring her here...!」

stage0046b_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$アルト$$
「About $$ジン$$...
　guess they're shaken up over it too...」

stage0046b_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:

stage0046b_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Why do I have to share a room with
　Daddy's Boy!?」

stage0046b_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Sorry, $$アスカ$$.
　My place isn't that big, just bear with it one night」

stage0046b_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「If I'd known, I should've stayed at
　$c's dorm instead...」

stage0046b_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「While I'm apologizing, one more thing...
　Just for today, stay by $$シンジ$$'s side」

stage0046b_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Why does that matter?
　Wasn't he an enemy spy from another world?」

stage0046b_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Moping over a guy like that...!」

stage0046b_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「But he was still a friend」

stage0046b_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ミサト$$
「He was an important friend to $$シンジ$$」

stage0046b_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$アスカ$$
「If you're asleep, fine...
　I'm just talking to myself now, though...」

stage0046b_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$アスカ$$
「We're EVA pilots...
　There's surely more pain and sorrow
　waiting for us, no matter how much...」

stage0046b_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$アスカ$$
「But I won't get out of EVA...
　Because that's the only place I belong...」

stage0046b_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「You can do whatever you want...
　But me... I'm never running away...」

stage0046b_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$アスカ$$
「That's it for talking to myself...
　Good night...」

stage0046b_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...Why did you bring me here...?」

stage0046b_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Because this is the only place left where I can
　remember the world your mother was part of.」

stage0046b_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...This red sea... does it connect to our old world...?」

stage0046b_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「People can go on living by forgetting their memories.
　But there are things one must never forget.」

stage0046b_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Yui taught me something irreplaceable.
　I come here to make sure I remember it.」

stage0046b_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Don't you have a photo, or something?」

stage0046b_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「None remain.
　...It's all in my heart now.
　That's enough, for now.」

stage0046b_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It's time.
　I'm heading back to NERV.」

stage0046b_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Why do I have to share a room with
　Daddy's Boy!?」

stage0046b_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Sorry, $$アスカ$$.
　My place isn't that big, just bear with it one night」

stage0046b_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$アスカ$$
「If I'd known, I should've stayed at
　$c's dorm instead...」

stage0046b_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:

stage0046b_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:

stage0046b_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:

「But he was still a friend」

stage0046b_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ミサト$$
「He was an important friend to $$シンジ$$」

stage0046b_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アスカ$$

stage0046b_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$アスカ$$

　There's surely more pain and sorrow
　waiting for us, no matter how much...」

stage0046b_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$アスカ$$
「But I won't get out of EVA...
　Because that's the only place I belong...」

stage0046b_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$アスカ$$
「You can do whatever you want...
　But me... I'm never running away...」

stage0046b_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アスカ$$
「That's it for talking to myself...
　Good night...」

stage0046b_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「...If only I had answered him...」

stage0046b_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$ジン$$ said to me...
　'Come with me,' he said...」

stage0046b_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（$$ユノハ$$ keeps fading more and more...!
　At this rate...!）

stage0046b_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「If I had answered that, $$ジン$$ might...」

stage0046b_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Let's go, $$ユノハ$$.
　Together with everyone」

stage0046b_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「No! I don't want to go! I don't want to say it...!
　I don't want to say goodbye to $$ジン$$!」

stage0046b_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$シンジ$$ came too...!
　You're the only one left, $$ユノハ$$!」

stage0046b_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「No! I don't want to go!
　$$ジン$$... $$ジン$$!!」

stage0046b_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「You don't have to say goodbye!
　I don't want to say it either...!
　Not to $$ジン$$... not to $$ユノハ$$...!」

stage0046b_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I love $$ユノハ$$... you matter to me...!
　So please!
　Don't disappear from us, $$ユノハ$$!」

stage0046b_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$トウジ$$
「...that $$ジン$$... he really did go and die...」

stage0046b_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「$$シンジ$$ and the rest of the volunteer club...
　one wrong step and...」

stage0046b_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$クレア$$
「...There's something I'd like to tell all of you,
　now that you've gathered here」

stage0046b_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$クレア$$
「$$ジン・ムソウ$$ came from a world
　called Altair」

stage0046b_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$クレア$$
「From the data device $$ジン・ムソウ$$ carried,
　his true purpose has come to light」

stage0046b_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$クレア$$
「He was trying to carry off female Elements
　to the world of Altair」

stage0046b_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$葵$$
「So it's not that he targeted women at
　random, but Elements specifically...?」

stage0046b_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$桂$$
「So $$ユノハ$$ was the one they chose...」

stage0046b_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$アマタ$$
（I think I get it now, somehow...
　That sight I saw as a kid...
　Mom went to Altair too...）

stage0046b_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$クレア$$
「We don't know exactly why they targeted
　female Elements」

stage0046b_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$クレア$$
「But now that Altair has taken
　a more direct approach, the fighting
　is bound to intensify from here」

stage0046b_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$ジン・ムソウ$$... I'll call him $$ジン$$, on purpose...
　I respect your grief over $$ジン$$'s death」

stage0046b_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ミサト$$
「But I need you to make peace with it.
　It may be cruel, but it's your duty to do so」

stage0046b_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Just switching our feelings off like that...」

stage0046b_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$アンディ$$
「You call that a duty...!?
　People aren't built that simple!」

stage0046b_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You do it anyway.
　Those who can't get dragged down by the dead」

stage0046b_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Even if you tell us that...!」

stage0046b_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$シモン$$
「The dead are dead...
　They're just not here anymore...!」

stage0046b_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$シモン$$
「But that doesn't mean they vanished...!
　They're with us, always!」

stage0046b_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「That guy...!
　Read the room!」

stage0046b_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Stop, my friend.
　This is... a sound of grief」

stage0046b_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Look around you.
　Except for us and a few others, everyone
　is getting past death and despair, their own way」

stage0046b_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$バナージ$$
（To live...
　is to keep reaching for what's possible...）

stage0046b_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$バナージ$$
（The one who entrusted me with the Unicorn...
　I'm alive, so I can't let that go to waste）

stage0046b_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$宗介$$
（A comrade's death...
　It's a fact I must accept...）

stage0046b_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Goodbye, $$ジン$$...
　I'll... never forget you...）

stage0046b_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I'll... do my best to keep living...）

stage0046b_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Looks like, of everyone in $c,
　we're the naivest about death.」

stage0046b_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Good timing.
　We should recognize it now, I suppose,
　that we're somewhere life and death are at stake.」

stage0046b_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$不動$$
「Saves me the trouble of explaining what comes next.」

stage0046b_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$不動$$
「$$シモン$$, $$アンディ$$... dig a hole.」

stage0046b_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$不動$$
「And in that hole, the Elements will be buried.」

stage0046b_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$不動$$
「I dub it... the Grave Pit Drill!」

stage0046b_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$不動$$
「There, you will learn about death.」

stage0046b_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Everyone's hurting, and yet!
　What you're saying makes no sense at all!」

stage0046b_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$不動$$
「By sleeping alongside the dead who rest here,
　your attachment to life will grow remarkably.」

stage0046b_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$不動$$
「Distraction, malice, grief, obsession, grudges...
　All these notions rob your soul of freedom,
　and become shackles on a battlefield beside death...」

stage0046b_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$不動$$
「All of you must die here, once...!」

stage0046b_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$不動$$
「Blow out your attachment to life, and sever it...
　What lies at the end of a mock death...
　See it for yourself, with your own eyes!」

stage0046b_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$スズネ$$
「And for that... we get buried in a hole...」

stage0046b_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$n
「...I have to get past it too...」

stage0046b_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$シュレード$$
「I'm already as good as in my coffin.
　A rehearsal for a death that's not far off isn't bad.」

stage0046b_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「I want... to be close...
　Even a little, close to $$ジン$$...」

stage0046b_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「This nasty hole... guess I fill it myself...」

stage0046b_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Filling in a hole we worked so hard to dig,
　now that's a real killer!
　Fine, I'll just jump in myself!」

stage0046b_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I don't want to! Absolutely not!!」

stage0046b_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Those eyes that see right through everything...!
　I really hate them!」

stage0046b_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$不動$$
「That's... fine.
　...But you, you're not allowed to run.」

stage0046b_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$クレア$$
「Well then, Colonel Katsuragi...
　the Elements and $F...
　I'll look after them for a while.」

stage0046b_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$シモン$$
「Everyone ready?
　We're covering you with dirt.」

stage0046b_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, $$バサラ$$!
　This isn't the time for irresponsible talk!」

stage0046b_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$不動$$
「Do you understand it, $$熱気バサラ$$?」

stage0046b_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$バサラ$$
「A guitar played into air stretched taut... right?」

stage0046b_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「...The battle's already begun.
　Are we really okay not going?」

stage0046b_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$不動$$
「If you went now, you'd only be a hindrance.」

stage0046b_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Supreme Commander $$不動$$... may I ask you something?」

stage0046b_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's about $n's $$ブーストアップ$$.
　Is that an Element ability too?」

stage0046b_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Is it like the children with the bloodied eyes?」

stage0046b_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$不動$$
「You could say the source is one and the same.
　But depending on who receives it,
　it comes to walk an entirely different path.」

stage0046b_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't quite follow what you're saying...」

stage0046b_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$不動$$
「No need to worry.
　With that power, whether you fall to
　Heaven's Prison or break Time's is up to you.」

stage0046b_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$不動$$
「Good opportunity.
　You should face yourself too.」

stage0046b_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$シュレード$$
（There's a sound...
　The presence of insects crawling through soil...
　Something burrowing through, squirming...」

stage0046b_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$カイエン$$
（It's disgusting...
　Like maggots crawling into my pores, like this...）

stage0046b_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$モロイ$$
（Like my body's slowly crumbling away...）

stage0046b_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$サザンカ$$
（Like I'm slowly rotting away...）

stage0046b_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ユノハ$$
（If I rot... and rotting, return to the earth,
　could $$ジン$$ and I... become one...?）

stage0046b_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
（I'm scared...!
　Returning to the earth...? I can't go back...!）

stage0046b_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$n
（If I just die like this...
　then I... won't have to fight fear anymore... is that it...）

stage0046b_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$n
（Is it... okay to stop fearing loss...）

stage0046b_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$不動$$
「$$アマタ$$'s power, Flight... $$ゼシカ$$'s power, Twist...
　$$シュレード$$'s sound... $$カイエン$$'s despair...
　and then, $$ユノハ$$'s power, Vanish...」

stage0046b_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$不動$$
「Each of their thoughts is running wild.
　At this rate...」

stage0046b_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「No, $$ユノハ$$!
　You can't just disappear!」

stage0046b_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「We finally got to be friends...!
　I thought we'd finally get to connect...!」

stage0046b_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Why...! Come back here again, please!
　Hey, everyone!!」

stage0046b_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$アマタ$$
「If I'm born, I'll just be left behind again.
　I don't want that... never be left behind again...!」

stage0046b_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Left behind...!
　$$アマタ$$'s being left behind...!」

stage0046b_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「No more...! I hate this...! Don't leave me...!
　I want to stay here...!
　Here with $$ジン$$, just like this...!」

stage0046b_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I don't want to be born... not again, ever...!」

stage0046b_03:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「W-what is this...!?
　Everyone's sorrow is spreading...!」

stage0046b_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Stop...! Just stop it!
　You're all such idiots!!
　What is this!?」

stage0046b_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$不動$$
「$$碇シンジ$$...
　Meeting $$ジン$$ made you feel the
　Elements' walls of the heart, didn't it...」

stage0046b_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$不動$$
「$$ミコノ・スズシロ$$...
　It's your power that will save them.」

stage0046b_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$不動$$
「A person doesn't only die when life ends.
　Like hair falling, teeth dropping, withering away,
　the body's cells, mind and heart die moment by moment...」

stage0046b_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$不動$$
「But when bound to a past self and frozen,
　a person is cut off from the universe's
　great flow, and falls apart...」

stage0046b_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$不動$$
「$$ミコノ・スズシロ$$...
　Your power binds the scattered back together...」

stage0046b_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$不動$$
「Yes, that attachment to a past self...
　Like mushroom threads that feed on the dead
　and grow, beneath unseen earth...」

stage0046b_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$不動$$
「Between life and death,
　it binds the souls that were torn apart...」

stage0046b_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$不動$$
「$$ミコノ・スズシロ$$...
　It's your power that will save the Elements.」

stage0046b_03:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$不動$$
「A person doesn't only die when life ends.
　Like hair falling, teeth dropping, withering away,
　the body's cells, mind and heart die moment by moment...」

stage0046b_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$不動$$
「But when bound to a past self and frozen,
　a person is cut off from the universe's
　great flow, and falls apart...」

stage0046b_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$不動$$
「$$ミコノ・スズシロ$$...
　Your power binds the scattered back together...」

stage0046b_03:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$不動$$
「Yes, that attachment to a past self...
　Like mushroom threads that feed on the dead
　and grow, beneath unseen earth...」

stage0046b_03:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$不動$$
「Between life and death,
　it binds the souls that were torn apart...」

stage0046b_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ジン$$
「I've loved you for twelve thousand years...」

stage0046b_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$ジン$$
「From year eight thousand on, I missed you more.」

stage0046b_03:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$ジン$$
「I was always alone.
　I thought other people didn't matter.」

stage0046b_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$ジン$$
「But $$ユノハ$$... meeting you, all of you,
　made me wish to connect with someone.」

stage0046b_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$ジン$$
「So don't let the flow of life stop.
　And, everyone...」

stage0046b_03:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$ジン$$
「I know now that I'm not alone...!
　Our lives were never meant to be alone...!」

stage0046b_03:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「That's right...!
　Our lives go beyond life and death,
　connecting together, right now...!」

stage0046b_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$モロイ$$
「It's like the dead became a cradle...!」

stage0046b_03:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It feels like being held again
　in mother's arms as a baby...!」

stage0046b_03:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Right... if I'd never been born,
　I'd never have felt this...!」

stage0046b_03:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「If I'd never been born, I'd never have
　met any of you, or $$ジン$$...!」

stage0046b_03:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Sure, there's danger out there!
　But it's just as warm as inside the hole!」

stage0046b_03:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「To reach for warmth,
　you'll get hurt, you'll feel pain...!
　Even so...!」

stage0046b_03:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$シュレード$$
「A sound lives only between death and rebirth...!」

stage0046b_03:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「That's right! Everyone, don't be afraid!
　I'll be waiting here for you!
　Waiting for you all to be born again!」

stage0046b_03:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$不動$$
「In the flow of passing time,
　you die each moment, reborn each moment.
　Where being is born from nothing, that is now...!」

stage0046b_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$不動$$
「Bind this moment called 'now' with your heart!」

stage0046b_03:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$不動$$
「Behold, the Union of Mind and Truth!!」

stage0046b_03:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「No way! Is that kid still in the dirt!?」

stage0046b_03:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone...
　I'll stay with $n.
　Please launch, quickly.」

stage0046b_03:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$不動$$
「Then, I'll leave the rest to you.」

stage0046b_03:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$不動$$
「All hands, launch!
　Elements: $$アマタ$$, $$ミコノ$$, $$ゼシカ$$!」

stage0046b_03:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Not that Supreme Commander $$不動$$ told me to,
　but since I'm always asking $n things,
　today I'll talk about myself for once...」

stage0046b_03:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I always act mature and lecture you...
　but I'm not really someone who can do that.」

stage0046b_03:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The real me is weak, and a coward...」

stage0046b_03:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$n
「...I didn't really understand what Supreme
　Commander $$不動$$ meant about life and death...」

stage0046b_03:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$n
「But when I thought Miss $$スズネ$$ was in danger,
　my body just moved on its own...」

stage0046b_03:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$ told me...
　that wanting to protect someone
　becomes your strength, $n...」

stage0046b_03:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You've saved me so many times, $n...
　My life is a life you, $n, saved for me.」

stage0046b_03:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Your life has meaning...
　let it become the strength to protect someone.」

stage0046b_03:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's right.
　Even if chasing an angel began your fight,
　you're fighting to protect something now.」

stage0046b_03:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So live...
　to protect someone with your life.」

stage0046b_03:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's go!
　Before that UG leader unit comes back!」

stage0046b_03:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$n
「Since I just used $$ブーストアップ$$,
　we'll have to run to the hangar!」

stage0046b_03:r_cc01b694a39de719.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Our joined hands are so warm...
　I can feel $n's heart...）

stage0046b_03:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$スズネ$$
（But, what is this...
　something stirring deep in my heart...）

stage0046b_03:r_8b22d4b99ca35b84.text:
$$加持$$
「Whew, what a job that was.
　The Third Angel and EVA Unit-05 in question
　were dealt with as planned.」

stage0046b_03:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$加持$$
「Officially, it was an accident...
　This ends the Marduk Plan at Bethany Base.」

stage0046b_03:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$加持$$
「Everything went by your script.
　And the usual latest data from $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$, earlier...」

stage0046b_03:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$冬月$$
「I've had a look.
　Proof of Mark.06's construction was useful.」

stage0046b_03:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$加持$$
「Very well.
　Here's the item as promised.」

stage0046b_03:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$加持$$
「The Lost Number kept in reserve,
　a guide that weaves god and soul together.」

stage0046b_03:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Yes...
　the Key of Nebuchadnezzar, door to Instrumentality.」

stage0046b_03:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$加持$$
「Well then, I'll be off.
　I'll do as I please for a while.」

stage0046b_03:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$冬月$$
「Chief Inspector $$加持リョウジ$$...
　Is he a man worth trusting?」

stage0046b_03:r_2488b984097a7bdf.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Welcome back, my sweet honey.」

stage0046b_03:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I'm sorry...
　Launching without orders, and failing my goal besides...」

stage0046b_03:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I'm the one who stained the pride of G.」

stage0046b_03:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Quit thinking such dangerous thoughts.
　You're our last hope, after all.」

stage0046b_03:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't worry about it, don't worry.
　The clock's hands will stop soon enough anyway.」

stage0046b_03:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But, always losing does sting a little...」

stage0046b_03:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That $c of ours needs
　a bit of punishment, imitation
　included. Pretty seriously, too.」

stage0046b_03:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Once we've hit that pesky island,
　I think we'll let them taste
　despair a little early.」

stage0046b_03:r_d4f3fe1e9bcf2590.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't worry, $$アンナロッタ$$.
　This guy here's just my drinking buddy.」

stage0046b_03:r_59cb6a337266e5c9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Though it's always on me, mind you.」

stage0046b_03:r_521653467873650f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
（What is this guy...）

stage0046b_03:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You did it, $n!
　You managed to activate GAI Mode!」

stage0046b_03:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$n
「Was that... thanks to $$ミコノ$$'s power to connect?」

stage0046b_03:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since $n isn't an Element,
　I'd say it's just a side effect.」

stage0046b_03:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This activation happened because
　the Grave Pit Drill briefly made you
　open to Element power. Irregular, so to speak.」

stage0046b_03:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But thanks to the data we got,
　we're almost able to pin down the conditions.」

stage0046b_03:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since a Z-Chip was generated
　on activation, I think the pilot's
　mental state does have an effect.」

stage0046b_03:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is just my guess,
　but sensing Miss $$スズネ$$'s mind directly
　likely caused some change in $n.」

stage0046b_03:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Anyway, I'll add the 100Z Z-Chip
　from this activation to the squad's stock.」

stage0046b_03:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$n
「...I'd call this the Grave Pit Drill's payoff.」

stage0046b_03:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Want to bury yourself in dirt
　before every sortie from now on? If so,
　I'll get a huge planter ready in the hangar.」

stage0046b_03:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... I like that jokes don't land with you...」

stage0046b_03:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
$n
「If anger is what turns the $$ジェニオン$$
　into GAI, I'm sure I could trigger it right now...」

stage0046b_03:r_c627120a60cde94d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...That was quite an ordeal, Lady $$ユノハ$$.」

stage0046b_03:r_22a2d3667e5a9fc8.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$...
　But I'm alright now.」

stage0046b_03:r_62e68b17a29fb53b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You've changed so much since we first met.
　To see you smile like that...
　it makes this $$ＡＧ$$ happy too.」

stage0046b_03:r_3f09ae47d355cbc5.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「For $$ジン$$, who taught me what it means
　to cherish someone, I'll... keep trying.」

stage0046b_03:r_629b0e87b7bc7b76.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Well then, I have meal duty soon,
　so please excuse me.」

stage0046b_03:r_ede6dd5bb2efe029.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But this time's Grave Pit Drill...
　left something bothering me.」

stage0046b_03:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just who is Supreme Commander $$不動$$,
　really...? And what he said about the heavens...」

stage0046b_03:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$不動$$
「Do you need something from me?」

stage0046b_03:r_e81e034b71411af7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Whoa!
　W-what was that all of a sudden!?」

stage0046b_03:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-what is it...?
　Looking at me like you can see through my armor...」

stage0046b_03:r_f2d72b948cc38cfe.text:
$$不動$$
「Things are more interesting with secrets.
　We are too... and so is she...」

stage0046b_03:r_3b207a6e3b8e5700.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Are you going to cloud the issue again
　with words like that?」

stage0046b_03:r_2cd57aac659672dc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those eyes that see through everything...!
　I hate them so much!」

stage0046b_03:r_017c609cb5528ca1.text:
$$不動$$
「Not much of a resemblance, hm.」

stage0046b_03:r_984737d2920b03f7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「J-just leave me alone!
　I will fulfill my own duty!」

stage0046b_03:r_5ce10ef5943775df.text:
$$不動$$
「Fired up for business, business, today too!」

stage0046b_03:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$不動$$
「Fate changes within the wheel of reincarnation.
　Catchphrases, and loved ones too...」
